title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper GPU Lossy Compression for HPC Can Be Versatile and Ultra-Fast
problem: Artifact reproducibility and evaluation of published SC research requires systematic evaluation against artifact evaluation criteria. This report documents reproducibility assessment of GPU lossy compression work.
motivation: SC reproducibility initiative aims to validate published research artifacts and ensure methodological rigor. Systematic artifact evaluation provides trust and enables community reuse.
method: An independent member of the SC25 reproducibility committee systematically tests whether the published GPU lossy compression artifacts actually work as described. They run the code and data, evaluate the results against the official SC25 Artifact Description and Evaluation criteria, and document their findings. This process checks whether other researchers can actually reproduce the original paper's work.
key_novelty: This report independently verifies whether a published GPU lossy compression artifact actually works and can be reproduced, following established evaluation standards.
contributions: Independent artifact evaluation for GPU lossy compression paper
Validation of research claims and results
limitations: Reproducibility report focused on artifact evaluation, not research novelty
Limited technical details provided in abstract
Specific findings and issues not summarized in abstract
